authorization.rule: Reread group membership and fail closed before reading the batch or item on every call.

request.expectedItemETag: SharePoint item ETag returned by Read Approval Item TEST ONLY
request.expectedDraftVersion: integer returned by Read Approval Item TEST ONLY
request.decisionReason: trimmed string containing at most 1200 characters; required for exclude

canonicalDraft.algorithm: Parse the immutable captured source object, replace only entry.summary, and serialize the resulting object once with the cloud-flow string function.
canonicalDraft.encoding: base64(UTF-8 canonical JSON), split after character 45000 into DraftProjectionBase64A and DraftProjectionBase64B
canonicalDraft.fingerprint: DraftDigest stores b64-edge-v1:<length>:<first 96 Base64 characters>:<last 96 Base64 characters>.
canonicalDraft.fingerprintSecurity: The fingerprint is deterministic but is not cryptographic and is never used alone for equality, authorization, or concurrency.
canonicalDraft.exactEquality: Concatenate and compare the complete two-part Base64 value. SharePoint item ETag and DraftVersion are the concurrency authority.

rules: The batch exists exactly once and State.Value is Ready.
The BatchId and SourceItemId pair resolves exactly once.
Decision is one of unresolved, approve, or exclude.
DecisionReason contains at most 1200 trimmed characters.

write.operation: SharePoint REST MERGE with X-HTTP-Method MERGE and IF-MATCH set to the reread item ETag
audit: DraftVersion increments by one only for a changed save.
DraftModifiedByEmail is the normalized trigger caller.
DraftModifiedAtUtc is one captured UTC instant.
write.readback: After a successful conditional write, reread the exact item and compare complete encoded draft bytes, fingerprint, version, modifier, modified instant, decision, reason, validation state, and changed ETag before returning saved.

idempotency.unchanged: If the current complete draft bytes, decision, trimmed reason, and Valid state already equal the request, return unchanged without writing even when the caller repeats the pre-save ETag after a lost response.
idempotency.conflict: If content differs and either expected ETag or expected DraftVersion is stale, return conflict with the current item and do not write.
idempotency.conditionalRace: If another write wins after the reread, the IF-MATCH request fails and returns conflict; it never retries as an unconditional write.

responses.saved: Changed request was written and exactly reread.
responses.unchanged: Requested state already exists; no write or version increment occurred.
responses.conflict: Current item JSON is returned for explicit reload/merge while the app retains the local edit.
responses.invalid: Validation errors are returned and no write occurs.
responses.batch-not-ready: Batch is absent, ambiguous, or not Ready; no item payload is returned.
responses.forbidden: Caller is not a current reviewer; no batch or item payload is returned.
responses.failed: Lookup or exact-readback result is uncertain; reload before retrying.

app.name: [PROTOTYPE] Intake Approval
app.publication: The PA-37 app remains saved and unpublished.
app.localEditRule: AI generation and Use suggestion remain local; only the save control calls the flow.
app.conflictRecovery: Keep the local summary, show the current server item, and require an explicit reload or merge before a later save.
app.validationStatus: Saving and Failed were exercised in live preview. Saved and Conflict are formula-clean but await a refreshed seven-input Power Apps V2 binding before live acceptance.

finalization: Disabled; this flow cannot change batch state, approved identities, approved payload fields, or the approved projections library.
